headline: Executive order creates military medals to recognize service in the Global War on Terrorism.
what_it_does: This order establishes new medals tied to the Global War on Terrorism, which began after the September 11, 2001 attacks. Based on its title, it creates awards that can be given to recognize people's service in that effort. No summary was provided, so details such as who qualifies and how the medals are awarded are not covered here.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the U.S. armed forces
who_it_affects.how: Service members who meet the requirements may be eligible to receive the new medals for their service in the Global War on Terrorism.
